compiledBy: orchestrator (Claude Opus 5 main session) — compiled from the five independent reviewer reports plus the verification record

defects.statement: K9 asserted 'the answer came back before the asking finished' while the implementation prevented the player from perceiving it: the ask anchor selected a mood with no question figure, so there was no sounding phrase for the answer to enter.
defects.requestedRepair: Realize the contract's own two-bar square-fifth ask figure so the answer enters inside a sounding question; K9 then confirms an observable.
defects.verificationRoute: Onset measurement of the ask-through-answer render vs the ch5-maw grammar reference.
defects.resolution: Closed: answer enters at beat 3, 25.0% into a 7.06s figure, gapless (0ms), unaccented (-25.99 to -27.06 dB), click-free (0.0187); [0,7] sounds through the boundary.

defects.statement: Carrier and variant state were set on anchor edges, so a mid-transit reload restored the pulse the seam had ebbed away and dropped the resolve's octave double — losing both of the chapter's signature gestures.
defects.requestedRepair: Resolve variant and carrier purely from durable milestones in enterEmergentScoreBeat.
defects.verificationRoute: 18-cell state matrix plus mid-transit reload equivalence test.
defects.resolution: Closed: resolveChapter10ScoreState reads beat + five durable milestones only; reload equivalence asserted.

defects.statement: The destination out-measured the A4 awakening on a steady-window comparison (pad 0.19 vs 0.18; -18.74 vs -18.84 dB), inverting the arc's intended weighting.
defects.requestedRepair: Pad to 0.17, sub to 0.10; re-measure on the 8-12s steady window.
defects.verificationRoute: Offline steady-window RMS/peak/sub comparison against the a4-authored control.
defects.resolution: Closed: -19.36 dB / peak 0.311 / sub -20.90 vs a4 -18.84 / 0.372 / -20.34 — strictly below on all three.

defects.statement: The manual player claims the bearing on foot at the relay and is then told 'HOLD [SPACE] TO IGNITE' with no locator to the Kestrel and a jetpack glyph on touch. The movie lane passed only because its autopilot was given a bespoke walk-and-board step, masking the missing rung.
defects.requestedRepair: Author and wire station:transit:reboard on ch8's boarding grammar; ignite publishes only once aboard.
defects.verificationRoute: Manual-lane guidance trace on both entry paths; assert [SPACE] absent on every on-foot rung.
defects.resolution: Closed in draft-v7 and wired; disembarking pre-ignition returns to the locator with a fresh cue.

defects.statement: LOW strips and HIGH stills appeared to render through different lenses (cockpit aperture 300px vs 705px), which would have invalidated every composition verdict.
defects.requestedRepair: Instrument the render camera on every ch10 flight frame at all four profiles.
defects.verificationRoute: Per-frame camera.fov / flight fov / drawing-buffer size / pixel ratio at four profiles.
defects.resolution: Not a lens defect: all four profiles bit-identical, canopy ~690px everywhere. The 300px frames were captured before the autopilot fixes and no longer reproduce. Cinematography accepts the diagnosis but holds all composition verdicts SUSPENDED until the strips are regenerated and re-measured.

defects.statement: The seam hero still is a second resolve frame (range 955, seam and resolve already latched) — the dot-to-line-to-place thesis has no line, and the still carried no acceptance criterion.
defects.requestedRepair: Re-shoot at the seam latch (5,100-5,200) against the new draft-v7 criterion stated in visual-angle units.
defects.verificationRoute: Anchor-triggered HIGH capture plus a paired LOW frame at the same latch edge.

defects.statement: ST-0 was in frustum on 1 of 8 crossing-strip frames (7/432 samples) — the strip proved the state machine, not the crossing. A blind viewer independently reported 'nothing crosses; it reads as a frozen game'.
defects.requestedRepair: Implement the movie-lane gaze bias to Cinematography's bounded spec.
defects.verificationRoute: In-frustum acceptance: at least 4/8 strip frames and 60/432 samples.
defects.resolution: Root cause was the gaze solver, not the state machine: it aimed 240m out in travel mode and clamped pitch to +15deg, solving 0.00deg at every elevation ST-0 occupies. Worst error now 0.00deg. In-frustum acceptance is the verifier's to confirm.

defects.statement: A cyan hexagonal berth ring rendered below the dock in the cut-line hero frame, violating the contract's 'no dock offer geometry' term in the one shot whose thesis is a closed door.
defects.requestedRepair: Suppress dock-offer geometry in story worlds under story:station-docking-authorized; sandbox byte-identical.
defects.verificationRoute: Story-mode vs sandbox comparison frames; exact-count tests on the suppressed elements.
defects.resolution: Closed under lock R9: the offer (4 guide arms, 28 chase lamps, 36 threshold strips) is fenced at the mount; the dock's jamb, mouth and glow are architecture and untouched; sandbox proven by exact-count tests.

defects.statement: The contracted 2.5s thrust-cold hold withheld nothing in manual flight: setStoryMoveScale(0) is read by nothing in ShipController, so the hold existed only in the movie lane.
defects.requestedRepair: Wire thrust-input suppression for HOLD_DURATION_MS with attitude and look left live.
defects.verificationRoute: Manual-flight probe: thrust suppressed for the window, attitude live, suppression ends at handback.
defects.resolution: Wired; manual-probe acceptance added to draft-v7. Verifier confirmation outstanding.

defects.statement: The ST-0 quad drew through ridges and shelter geometry, and ST0_MAX_PIXELS was dead while the clamp pinned 2.4px forever.
defects.requestedRepair: Honest occlusion within the one-draw-call budget; wire or delete the dead constant.
defects.verificationRoute: Low-elevation draw-through check plus device-projected size against the 3px ceiling at four profiles.
defects.resolution: Closed: depthTest live; clamp replaced by st0DeviceProjectedPixels() measured across 144 tier/DPR/viewport/distance cases.

defects.statement: The origin-side landfall leg intermittently never completed (2 of 4 crossings; worst 89.4s stand) because completion depended on arrival position rather than on an aimed descent.
defects.requestedRepair: Aim the origin-side descent at the derivable wreck site.
defects.verificationRoute: Repeated cold crossings; frequency and timing distribution.
defects.resolution: Closed on frequency: 8/8 post-fix completions at 5.1-7.8s. Residual: no post-fix run observed off this headless SwiftShader box.

defects.statement: The station target telemetry reads null for 1.81s between the bearing claim and the beat flip.
defects.requestedRepair: Publish the committed target in the same frame as the claim receipt, or record the gap as authored.
defects.verificationRoute: Telemetry pin trace across the claim.

defects.statement: Three independent reviewers read the station reveal as under-scaled: the blind viewer ('too small for the biggest image; nothing you would remember'), the canon auditor (the answer's continuation reads as thinning), and the score auditor (the answer enters ~6dB under the ask's own mean). The score lane's position is that the withholding is the point and the station's key is banked for the docking run.
defects.requestedRepair: Owner ear on the two renders; either accept the restraint or commission a reveal packet.
defects.verificationRoute: Owner listening session; no machine route can settle it.

defects.statement: Owner-reported from headed play: flying to the station and receiving complete silence inside the corridor is contract-correct, but reads as an unfinished game rather than as a deliberately closed door.
defects.requestedRepair: One authored beat, in the chapter's own voice, that makes the withholding legible as a choice.
defects.verificationRoute: Owner decision, then a chapter-authored line and a headed re-check.

defects.statement: On mobile-potato the entire ch10 work order renders as a JOURNAL button at all six anchors, so the chapter's unannounced arrival is a small button on touch.
defects.requestedRepair: Whole-game mobile guidance packet; a ch10-scoped affordance was rejected as forking guidance.
defects.resolution: Accepted exception: shipped baseline, HUD surfaces outside this lock; the mobile arrival is carried by the K1 caption.

defects.statement: story-authority.json raises the runtime story ceiling and evidence chain to ch10, but activeProduction still names the 2026-07-13 run; the gate pins production identity in five coupled literals.
defects.requestedRepair: A second registered production: schema, gate design, and its own lock revision.
defects.resolution: Accepted as coherent: no artifact claims otherwise, and retargeting today would drop the signed A4-to-ch9 contract out of gate coverage.

notes: Severity uses the reviewers' own words. 'resolved' means a repair landed AND was proven; 'resolved-reclassified' means the finding was disproved as stated; 'open-evidence' means the fix is code-complete but its proof is outstanding with the verifier; 'open-taste' means no machine route can settle it.

D-A1 is resolved as a diagnosis but Cinematography's draft-v7 signature keeps every composition verdict in verification-report.json formally SUSPENDED until the stale strips are regenerated and re-measured. That suspension is the single largest open item against the judge's evidence base.

Cinematography also recorded, without patching it, that four sites carry a mobile occupancy figure of about 26% derived from a superseded desktop number; it must be re-derived before any verifier measures mobile occupancy against a band.
